_readme: This project's own shared append-only registries — the kit applied to the
repository that ships it. See starter-kit/rules/shared-registries.md.
id_scheme is 'numeric' rather than the kit's 'slug' default because this
repository's decision records are numbered, and filenames follow the MADR
convention adr-NNNN-short-title.md — hence filename_prefix 'adr-' and
id_width 4. The filename_prefix is part of the path only; the identifier
stays ADR-0001, carried by id_prefix.
The widening from three digits to four did renumber ADR-001 to ADR-0001.
That was a deliberate, approved exception to the never-renumber rule: every
citation was updated in the same change except the one inside the released
[0.1.0] changelog section, which is immutable, so it is corrected by an
erratum bullet under [Unreleased] instead.
There is no debugging-knowledge-base registry here: this repository ships
the knowledge-base skeleton as a template rather than keeping one of its
own. A registry is declared when it exists, never speculatively.
graph.nodes says where this repository keeps each kind of artifact, for
the typed-link gate (starter-kit/scripts/graph_tool.py). An installed
repository needs no such block — the tool's defaults are the installed
locations. This one keeps its rules, skills, agents and scripts under
starter-kit/, so the map points there and the shipped files are checked
here exactly as they will be once installed.
